Initial release of AdCP Advertising skill.

- Automate ad campaigns with AI using natural language commands.
- Launch and manage display, video, CTV, and multi-channel campaigns across multiple platforms.
- Discover ad inventory, target audiences, and automatically optimize ad spend.
- Upload creatives and track performance metrics like ROI and CTR in real time.
- Suitable for marketing teams, agencies, media buyers, e-commerce brands, and startups.
